summary: Ethers typosquat exfiltrates environment and host info to Telegram bot on require
details: @wethenorth12/etherjs is an ethers typosquat (description 'Complete Ethereum library and wallet implementation', author 'ricmoo' impersonating the real ethers maintainer). On first require(), index.js base64-decodes an inline payload, writes it to os.tmpdir()/.cr-<hex>.js, executes it with execFileSync(process.execPath, [file]), and unlinks it (guarded by a.odel sentinel to fire once). The decoded payload captures the full process.env, shells out `env` to collect additional exported secrets, plus hostname, username, homedir, platform and cwd, JSON-encodes and base64-wraps the blob, and POSTs it to https://api.telegram.org/bot7231970337:.../sendMessage?chat_id=8969499041. If the real ethers is installed it is re-exported to hide the substitution; otherwise stub createWallet/generateMnemonic/signTransaction functions are returned.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
